ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Rclone Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of RClone utility for exfiltration as used by various ransomwares strains like REvil, Conti, FiveHands, etc

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-config\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-no\\-check\\-certificate\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ copy\\ .*")) OR ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rclone\\\.exe$") OR process_description = "Rsync\ for\ cloud\ storage") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*pass.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*user.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*copy.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sync.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*config.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*lsd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*remote.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ls.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mega.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*pcloud.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ftp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ignore\\-existing.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*auto\\-confirm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*transfers.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*multi\\-thread\\-streams.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*no\\-check\\-certificate\\ .*")))
